base.causal_story: FY2026 reported sales follow midpoint management4-6percent guidance; international strength offsets North American weakness; modest productivity lowers SG&A intensity while reinvestment remains below5percent of sales.

value_reset_failure.causal_story: Named downside: Value Reset Failure. Demand deterioration and price cuts reduce revenue, commodity/distribution costs compress gross margin, overhead adjusts slowly, collections/inventory worsen. Cash falls, modeled funding rises and value declines. This is a separate AI-assisted scenario, not the locked human changed-input test.
